summary: Frontend testing for 4 new features (C: Monitoring Pengiriman, D: Laporan Rapat Mingguan, B: Isi Katalog dari Master, A: Wizard Impor). Features C and D tested successfully with minor UI issues. Features B and A require deep-link/redirect fixes.

ui_bugs.issue: Validation error not displayed to user when preorder SLA < normal SLA. Backend correctly returns HTTP 400, but UI doesn't show error message.
ui_bugs.test_evidence: USER STORY C3b: Set normal=10, preorder=5 → backend rejected with 400, but no error message appeared on screen

ui_bugs.issue: Modal overlay intercepts clicks on dialog buttons (Cancel button). Dialog backdrop blocks interaction.
ui_bugs.test_evidence: USER STORY C4: After opening SLA dialog for Tokopedia, clicking Cancel button timed out due to overlay interception

ui_bugs.issue: Deep-link marketing-weekly-report doesn't land on Weekly Report tab. Lands on Overview tab instead. makeRedirect('marketing-reports','weekly') may not be setting sessionStorage correctly.
ui_bugs.test_evidence: USER STORY D1: Navigating to ?portal=toko&module=marketing-weekly-report landed on Overview tab, not Rapat Mingguan tab

ui_bugs.issue: Deep-link marketing-catalog-from-master doesn't land on 'Isi dari Master' tab. Lands on Katalog tab instead. makeRedirect('marketing-catalog','from-master') may not be working.
ui_bugs.test_evidence: USER STORY B1: Navigating to ?portal=toko&module=marketing-catalog-from-master landed on main Katalog view, not 'Isi dari Master' tab
